aircraft_type_and_dimensions.reason: The existing simulator does not vary movement behavior by canonical model, dimensions, or category.

canonical_airport_and_dataset.reason: Airport metadata is preserved; synthetic geometry is resolved by the mapping document.

catering_vehicle.reason: Catering is a distinct finite vehicle capability and uses the existing routed fleet dispatcher.

delayed_service.reason: A requirement target maps to its generated aircraft task and uses existing task duration disruption behavior.

equipment_outage.reason: An indefinite outage on a targeted mapped vehicle uses the existing vehicle outage event; finite outage windows are unsupported because the simulator cannot restore the vehicle at an end time.

flight_arrival_and_departure.reason: Paired legs for one canonical aircraft become the existing RampLab arrival-turnaround operation; IDs remain in identity-map.json.

flight_delay.reason: Delay minutes adjust the targeted scheduled time before conversion to simulation seconds.

flight_schedule.reason: UTC timestamps are converted to integer simulator seconds from the earliest canonical operational event.

fuel_vehicle_and_baggage_vehicle.reason: Canonical fleet records map to distinct fueling and baggage capabilities; both use the existing finite routed fleet dispatcher.

gate_unavailability.reason: RampLab has no safe validated gate-resource outage behavior.

gates.reason: Canonical gate IDs resolve to explicit existing gate resources in the mapping.

lavatory_water_gpu_tug_stairs_air_start.reason: Each category maps to a distinct finite vehicle capability and uses existing routing, reservation, outage, and safety handling.

raw_source_provenance.reason: Goal 24A source filenames and hashes are copied by reference into the generated manifest.

route_closure.reason: Canonical route IDs must map to an existing edge and use the existing road event mechanism.

tug_service_cart_and_generic_vehicle.reason: Unmapped equipment remains metadata; a mapped tug or service cart uses only the capability explicitly selected by the airport mapping.

turnaround_requirements.reason: Mapped mobile service types require a matching finite routed vehicle; mapped crew services use finite abstract capacity. Missing required capability mappings block generation.
